components.signature_domain_quantification: For every actually admitted counting window under the stated realization, represented upper-minus-lower displacement is strictly positive.
components.representation: Uses actual admitted arrival endpoints and their projected order, not free endpoint placeholders.

components.signature_domain_quantification: For the same admitted window, frequency times its reciprocal period equals the field unit.
components.representation: Select the product conjunct of the native theorem; its positivity conjunct is retained as supporting evidence.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Strict natural count increase gives a strictly positive, hence nonzero, field-embedded natural count difference.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Under ReprCtx<=3 and QtyAffReal, every admitted window has positive represented difference and reciprocal product one; source values and normalization retain the explicitly enumerated generating dependencies.
components.representation: The mathematical conclusions are the stated positivity/product and the cited unique-source-value/normalization constructions. The generative stage prose records their dependency order; no empirical unit or primitive duration is imported.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Fix the same evaluation structure, law and chart. Diff2 establishes the generated curve and its finite jet on the actual numeric domain.
components.representation: Diff2 is a prerequisite, not a conclusion obtained from arbitrary relation membership.

components.signature_domain_quantification: For each selected law a, each chart chi and each theta in that same chart numeric domain, its own canonical generated jet belongs to its specified relation. Diff2 is fixed for the membership equivalence.
components.representation: MemberCondition supplies the explicit law/chart/theta quantifiers at fixed representation. The pointwise theorem diff3_restricts supplies membership. The auxiliary image lemma transports that actual member through any F, instantiated by the declared ambient flattening equivalence. It requires only Diff2 and Diff3, not complete Diff1--Diff5 or all-law validity. The family alignment root records quantified assembly, not an extra premise requiring every representation.

components.signature_domain_quantification: At each fixed law, time chart and base point, the same-value-chart jet change is the identity on every jet of its common domain.
components.representation: Lean subtype function equality and HOL equality at every carrier jet express the same complete-domain assertion. No equality outside the chart carrier is required.

components.signature_domain_quantification: At each fixed law and value chart, the same-time-chart change is identity at every jet of the common domain.
components.representation: The time base is a=b and the reverse coordinate map is id. Its unchanged value chart is a fixed parameter of the domain.

components.signature_domain_quantification: On a triple value-chart overlap, J:beta0->beta1 followed by K:beta1->beta2 equals H:beta0->beta2.
components.representation: Jet composition is K after J, coordinate composition is g after f. All maps are restricted to the stated triple overlap; the source openness and Ck regularity come from Diff1.

components.signature_domain_quantification: On a triple time-chart overlap, J:alpha0->alpha1 followed by K:alpha1->alpha2 equals H:alpha0->alpha2.
components.representation: The curve parameter uses inverse coordinate maps: g maps b to a, h maps d to b. Their composition is g after h, while jet composition is K after J. This reversal is retained in both provers.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Two value-jet maps obeying the given action on every admissible Ck curve germ agree on the entire jet domain at the fixed time base.
components.representation: Diff1 supplies the action and map existence. Polynomial realizations witness every jet; they do not replace the all-curves quantifier with polynomial-only assumptions.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Two time-jet maps obeying precomposition by the same reverse time chart agree on the entire jet domain, with the value chart fixed.
components.representation: Existence is inherited from Diff1. The same all-germs action and full-domain realization are retained; no independent arbitrary jet map is substituted.

components.signature_domain_quantification: For every finite order k and every jet whose zeroth value lies in the open value chart, a smooth polynomial realizes that jet; restricting to an open neighborhood respects both time and value charts.
components.representation: No finite bound k<=6 is introduced. The bounded CAS polynomial tests are separate supporting checks, not the proof of this all-finite-order statement.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The forward and inverse chart maps have Ck regularity; derivative indices satisfy 0<=r<=k. These are proof parameters, not seven new mathematical objects.
components.representation: The reviewed proof invokes chain-rule action from Diff1. The action remains quantified over all Ck curve germs in both backends.

components.representation: The checked theorem only needs the surjectivity part of bijectivity, hence is stronger rather than more conditional. Typed Lean sets encode subset guards; HOL retains explicit A subset X and B subset Y.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Under exactly the stated image premises, F(A)=B.
components.representation: Both inclusions, including extraction of a source preimage, are retained.

components.signature_domain_quantification: If y=F(x) with x in A, use A subset X and the forward membership implication to conclude y in B.
components.representation: The displayed x and y occurrences are locally bound proof witnesses; no new global objects are counted.

components.signature_domain_quantification: For y in B subset Y, surjectivity supplies x in X with F(x)=y; the reverse membership implication gives x in A and therefore y in F(A).
components.representation: Surjectivity is used only after target-carrier membership; omitting B subset Y would be invalid in the carrier-set encoding.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The same evaluation structure satisfies Diff1, so its chart changes and their jet action are defined.
components.representation: This is the stated prerequisite of Diff4, not an assumption to insert into the weaker Diff3 membership statement.

components.signature_domain_quantification: For every selected law, fixed time chart, pair of value charts and every jet in their full change domain, source relation membership iff changed-jet membership in the target relation.
components.representation: This quantifies over all overlap jets, not only generated trajectories. The ambient relation is restricted through source/target inclusions. components.signature_domain_quantification: For every typed input x, domain D and on-domain predicate P, K(x) iff there exists y in D with x=y and P(y).

components.signature_domain_quantification: For every fixed law a, quantify over every pair of time charts and every pair of value charts; retain the law-dependent finite order k_a.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Image, under the first time chart, of the intersection of the two time-chart source domains.

components.representation: Canonical restriction coherence transports the entire native recursion to this section. Selected data remain fixed throughout.

components.signature_domain_quantification: For each one of four states, all tokens having that state in the same fixed section.

components.signature_domain_quantification: FailedTok is exactly the failed-state fibre, not the complement of the sat fibre.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Each generator i -> x_ti is injective and onto its specified image; its inverse recovers the original index.
components.representation: The injection is the source assumption, not inferred from equal cardinalities or merely from indexing. Surjectivity follows from the image definition.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The total tagged image cardinality equals the sum of every finite index-fibre cardinality.
components.representation: The same injection hypothesis identifies each image cardinality with its index set. No counting by visually distinct displayed predicates is used.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The generator x_ti maps to the complete triple (t,i,P_ti); this is a bijection to the tagged object graph.
components.representation: Equal attached objects do not identify different (tag,index) pairs. The inverse uses the proved inverse of the generator map, retaining all three components.

components.signature_domain_quantification: A Boolean condition family indexed from 1 through n at each fixed y, with empty prior conjunction true.

components.signature_domain_quantification: A law component has the nine fields (X,Y,f,g,E,R,H,V,h), with H subset T, f:H-to-X, g:H-to-Y, E subset T-times-X, R subset E-times-Y, V=(T-times-X)-times-Y, and h(t)=((t,f(t)),g(t)).
components.representation: Lean stores X,Y as type parameters and H,f,g,E,R as Component fields; Tuple and evalTuple recover V,h. HOL explicit carrier and typing clauses represent the same domains. Neither right uniqueness of R, nonempty H, nor membership h(t) in R is included at this stage.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Bij(S) is exactly the set of bijections from S to itself.
components.representation: A Reindex S S stores the forward map and its uniquely determined inverse with both identities. HOL reindex_on also restricts both map images to the same carrier. This is not a one-sided inverse or mere injective endomorphism.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The candidate family consists of a common time carrier, a nonempty law index set, one nine-field component per index, an allowed family of common time subsets, and a subset of the product of full-tuple self-bijection sets.
components.representation: All indexed input/output carriers remain dependent on the law index. HOL well_typed_family expresses declared carrier restrictions and carrier-extensional membership of the faithful subset; the latter removes irrelevant total-function extensions. It does not add the later K4 invariance condition.

components.signature_domain_quantification: For each nonempty-family law index, the input and output observable-index subsets lie in the quotient observable indices. The two IOSide labels select those subsets; each evaluation-time domain lies within the real trajectory domain.
components.representation: The two fields inIndices/outIndices implement the two named sides. Each value-space product keeps the carrier of its own observable index. Empty input or output index subsets are allowed, while the law-index family itself remains nonempty.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Each input/output value is the entire selected indexed family of canonical real observable-curve values at t, in the corresponding product carrier. The four component projections select those two carriers and maps.
components.representation: Lean dependent functions and HOL PiE with restrict encode the same indexed product. No common value carrier is substituted for per-index ranges. The native context is instantiated by the previously descended canonical observable family.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The application domain lies in real trajectory time times the input-value product; the candidate relation lies in that application domain times the output-value product.
components.representation: candidateTyped is exactly the displayed relation inclusion, not an additional premise introduced for a proof. The evaluated tuple need not belong to that application domain until the later individual-admissibility condition is imposed.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The evaluation tuple is ((t,InVal(t)),OutVal(t)) on the individual evaluation-time domain, in the full tuple carrier. LawEvalComp is the ordered tuple of all nine named components.
components.representation: The type parameters, stored Component fields and derived Tuple/evalTuple jointly preserve the nine fields in the source order. The faithful family belongs to the enclosing family, not a tenth component.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The allowed common law-time domains form a supplied subset of the powerset of the actual real trajectory domain.
components.representation: A predicate on predicates of NativeTime represents this powerset family. No nonemptiness or selection of an allowed member is required by the definition.

components.signature_domain_quantification: For each law index, EvalTupleBijSet comprises self-bijections of its complete evaluation-tuple space; FaithTransSet is a supplied subset of their dependent product.
components.representation: The carrier includes time, input values and output values, not only time. Neither every self-bijection nor a nonempty faithful family is assumed. Invariance of candidate relations under those maps is a later K4 condition, not a consequence of the word faithful.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The generated candidate family has its actual real trajectory carrier, nonempty law indices, nine-field components, allowed common domains and faithful tuple-bijection families. A general law datum is a tagged evaluation specification paired with a candidate family. EvalCouplLoc selects the observer location in either specification branch.
components.representation: Time and index carriers are type parameters in Lean and explicit sets in HOL. The single generated datum is the inl branch of the general sum, not the entire law-datum space. Coupling uses the location projection of each branch; it does not identify single and joint specifications.

components.signature_domain_quantification: For arbitrary law data the named time, index, component and family projections recover the candidate fields. The nine component projections include both value carriers, input/output maps, application domain, candidate relation, time domain, full tuple carrier and evaluation tuple. Dot notation abbreviates these same projections.
components.representation: The full tuple carrier and tuple map are derived fields in the formal record; type parameters recover the input/output carriers. Neither dot notation nor the selected family projections change domains or silently impose K1 through K5.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The generated single evaluation specification, candidate structure and their ordered pair belong to their declared spaces, and all displayed projections equal the source components; EvalCouplLoc equals o.
components.representation: The native-family typing proof supplies exactly the component and carrier restrictions in the definition. The tagged sum injection and product constructor establish the outer memberships. This typing result does not establish law operability.

components.signature_domain_quantification: K1 holds precisely when every indexed evaluation-time domain is nonempty and every evaluated input pair belongs to its application domain.
components.representation: Lean quantifies over the time-domain subtype; HOL quantifies over the same explicit set. Nonemptiness is a separate conjunct and is not replaced by the typing of the input function.

components.signature_domain_quantification: For every law datum, law index and time in that component evaluation domain, (t,InVal(t)) belongs to LawTimeDom times InValSp, without a K1 hypothesis.
components.representation: HOL uses the declared well_typed_family carrier restrictions; Lean carries these restrictions in the time and input types. This result concerns the ambient product, not membership in EvalDom or CandRel.

components.signature_domain_quantification: RightUnique for a relation means that two related output values at the same input are equal; K2 requires this for every candidate relation.
components.representation: For a law component the relation input is the pair (time,input value). Quantifying over the ambient HOL types is equivalent to the printed bounded statement because candidate relations are contained in the declared domain times output carrier. Existence of an output at every ambient input is not required.

components.signature_domain_quantification: CandRelDom is the actual relational domain: precisely those application-domain inputs having at least one related output.
components.representation: Its input type is EvalPoint, the subtype of the actual EvalDom. The explicit HOL carrier guards are redundant under the declared relation inclusion. Neither full EvalDom nor the entire ambient time-value product is substituted for Dom(CandRel).

components.signature_domain_quantification: K2 gives a unique output function on the actual candidate-relation domain into the declared output carrier. Its graph is literally the complete candidate relation.
components.representation: Existence uses the witness in relational-domain membership, and right uniqueness fixes its value. Lean subtype-function equality corresponds to HOL equality restricted to that domain; total-function values outside the domain are irrelevant. Empty relations yield the unique empty-domain function, not an extra nonemptiness premise.

components.signature_domain_quantification: K3 consists of K1 together with candidate-relation membership of every generated evaluation tuple at every indexed evaluation time.
components.representation: The K1 conjunct is retained even though a relation membership can imply input-domain membership under typing: K1 also requires all individual time domains to be nonempty.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Under K1 the generated tuple ((t,InVal(t)),OutVal(t)) belongs to EvalDom times OutValSp for every index and evaluation time.
components.representation: K1 supplies input-pair membership in EvalDom; the already declared output function supplies output-carrier membership. This proposition does not assume K3 or infer tuple membership in CandRel.

components.signature_domain_quantification: K4 requires each admitted family of full-tuple self-bijections to carry each entire candidate relation onto itself.
components.representation: The quantifier is over the supplied faithful subset of the product of tuple-bijection spaces, not over every bijection. Image equality is two-sided and is stronger than mere forward inclusion.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Under K4, for every admitted family and every law index, the inverse tuple map exists, carries the candidate relation onto itself, and preserves membership in both directions on the full tuple carrier.
components.representation: The inverse exists by bijectivity of each supplied tuple transformation. Applying it to the forward image equality proves inverse image equality and then the membership biconditional. No closure of the faithful family under inverse is assumed or needed; HOL carrier guards express the printed full tuple domain.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The valid-time set is the individual evaluation-time domain intersected with the inverse image of the candidate relation under the evaluation tuple. The common valid-time set is the intersection over all nonempty-family law indices.
components.representation: ValidAt retains an evaluation-time membership witness. HOL common_times includes an explicit time-carrier guard; it equals the displayed intersection by common_times_as_intersection because indices are nonempty and every individual domain is contained in that carrier. No nonemptiness of the intersection is inferred.

components.signature_domain_quantification: K5 consists of K3, nonemptiness of the common valid-time set, and membership of that exact set in the supplied family of admissible common domains.
components.representation: The allowed-family predicate is tested on the full intersection, not on an arbitrary smaller nonempty subset. K3 and both additional conjuncts are preserved in each encoding.

components.signature_domain_quantification: K5 yields a nonempty common valid-time subset of the law time carrier. Every time in it belongs to each individual evaluation-time domain and satisfies every component candidate relation.
components.representation: The output is pointwise over all law indices, not existence of one satisfying component. Membership in the common intersection supplies individual membership and evaluated-relation membership; the allowed family supplies a time subset as in the source proof.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The law dependency graph has exactly five nodes, the ordered K1 through K5 condition vector, satisfaction by the selected vector component, and exactly the direct edges (1,3) and (3,5).
components.representation: The explicit index correspondence is paper i in 1..5, Lean Fin5 value i-1, and HOL Law_i. The path from 1 to 5 is an ancestor relation, not an additional direct edge. The vector contains the actual law predicates, not unrelated boolean parameters.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The graph is acyclic, its roots are exactly 1,2,4, ancestors of 3 are exactly {1}, ancestors of 5 are exactly {1,3}, and other ancestor sets are empty. Rank is (0,0,1,0,2) and strictly increases along every edge.
components.representation: All claims use the same one-based/zero-based node correspondence. ancestors_exact identifies the explicit finite ancestor relation with the nonempty transitive closure; acyclicity therefore excludes all directed cycles rather than only self-edges.

components.signature_domain_quantification: LawCondAll is universal satisfaction over the five-node set, equivalent to the conjunction of all five actual law predicates.
components.representation: The finite vector correspondence proves both directions. No individual condition is dropped because it implies, or follows from, another condition.

components.signature_domain_quantification: For every general law datum, LawOperative is DynReady of its tagged evaluation specification together with LawCondAll of its own candidate structure.
components.representation: The definition uses the actual datum fields and the complete branch-sensitive readiness predicate. It is not restricted to a later chosen single-datum family or replaced by selected-domain membership.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Along a bijection from the full law-time carrier to T-prime, retain the input/output carriers; transport the individual time domain, application domain and relation by images; precompose value maps with the restricted inverse; and conjugate the evaluation tuple accordingly.
components.representation: The tuple map changes only time in ((t,x),y). Lean predicate pullbacks under the inverse equal the displayed images by bijectivity; subtype input/output maps have exactly the transported individual domain. HOL total functions are interpreted only on their declared carriers. All nine fields, including derived tuple carrier and map, are retained.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The allowed-domain family is the family of images of its original members. Each faithful tuple-bijection family is conjugated by the corresponding tuple transport, and the transported faithful set is exactly their image family.
components.representation: An existential original family is retained; this is not the set of every target bijection. HOL carrier-extensional conjugacy ignores only values outside the tuple carriers, not any permitted tuple or law index. The conjugates are bijections by the same time bijection.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The transported outer datum retains the exact evaluation specification and belongs to LawEvalDatSp. Each of the five indexed conditions is equivalent before and after transport; the common valid-time set is exactly the image of its source set.
components.representation: Target typing is proved from bijection and original carrier restrictions. condition_preserved establishes five separate biconditionals, not merely equivalence of their conjunction. K4 uses conjugation of the complete relation family; K5 uses exact common-domain image, nonemptiness and allowed-family image. Both single and joint specification tags are unchanged.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Generated-compatible law data have their own evaluation specification in the ready set, an admitted embedding of that specification time base, and a law-time domain contained in the image of that base trajectory domain.
components.representation: The witness e is uniquely the evalSpec projection, so the existential source form is equivalent to the direct formal conjunction. Instantiate TimeBases.Point/domain/admitted by the previously generated Qe/De/Omega[e]. Inclusion allows a proper subdomain; it is not equality or an extra choice of representation. The declared time,gen-to-gen abbreviation changes no object.

components.signature_domain_quantification: LawTimeAdm is generated-domain compatibility together with all five law conditions of the same datum.
components.representation: The datum and representation remain linked through its evalSpec. This is stronger than arbitrary law operability: the generated-domain inclusion and admitted-embedding requirement remain explicit. No later selected-family restriction is imposed on this definition.

components.signature_domain_quantification: D0 is the preimage of the given law-time domain under the base embedding, inside De. Restrict both embeddings to this same D0; the change map is rho composed with the inverse base restriction, from the original law-time domain onto rho[D0].
components.representation: The original generated-domain inclusion makes the base restriction onto; embedding injectivity makes both restrictions one-to-one. The generic carrier-bijection construction therefore applies equally to single or joint ready time bases. The native single-object specialization uses Part and NewTime. Coordinate-change uniqueness is relative to the two fixed representations, not uniqueness of an embedding.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Transport at the base representation returns the entire base datum; transport to any admitted representation gives generated-compatible law data there. For the originally generated single-object datum, the source subdomain D0 is the full De.
components.representation: The full-family identity includes faithful transformations and admissible-domain families, not just component values. Lean record equality is matched by HOL same_family_content: equality of every carrier and relation and of every map/predicate on its declared domain. Specification preservation then gives outer datum identity. The new time carrier is rho[D0], contained in rho[De]; readiness and embedding admission are unchanged.

components.signature_domain_quantification: At the specified admitted representation, the observer-time law core is the pair of the generated dynamic description and the candidate structure transported to that same representation, under LawTimeAdm.
components.representation: The candidate is a projection of the transported datum, not the old candidate interpreted under a new coordinate. obs abbreviates obs,time in the already declared source convention; the chosen representation is retained as an argument.

components.signature_domain_quantification: LawTimeAdm gives a unique observer-time law core, all five conditions and nonempty common valid-time domain at that fixed representation.
components.representation: Generated compatibility supplies readiness; the unchanged single tag gives DynOperative for the same Ev. Dynamic-description uniqueness fixes the first component; the transported candidate projection fixes the second. K5 supplies common-domain nonemptiness. No existence of a different embedding or identity between different represented cores is asserted.

components.signature_domain_quantification: For generated-compatible law data, generated representability requires a nonempty common valid-time set contained both in rho[De] and in every evaluation-tuple inverse image of the corresponding candidate relation. LawOperative implies this complete condition.
components.representation: The general proof combines K5 with the supplied generated-domain inclusion; every component relation membership is preserved. NumericDatum uses the actual real law-time subset as a subtype, and the generic value map is its inclusion into reals. No physical trajectory surjectivity or newly assumed law-satisfaction hypothesis is added.

components.signature_domain_quantification: DynOperative gives a nonempty admitted real-order-embedding family, and for every member the dynamic description and witness exist uniquely.
components.representation: The real-embedding existence premise is exactly the relevant DynOperative conjunct; the remaining single-valuedness, fiber, descent and input data are the previously proved construction responsibilities. Universal quantification is over every embedding, with no unique-coordinate claim.

components.signature_domain_quantification: For a law-operative base generated single-object datum and every admitted rho, the core at rho exists uniquely and the transported law-evaluation time satisfies generated representability.
components.representation: Base readiness and all five conditions are extracted from the law-operative hypothesis. All five are transported to the new candidate; actual new time is the image of the same original trajectory domain. transported_law_generation retains every candidate-relation membership as well as nonemptiness and generated-image inclusion. Merely preserving a vector of truth values is not used.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Concatenating finite tuples preserves each component in order, places all m first components before all n second components, and supports the displayed 3+2+2 flattening.
components.representation: Lean uses a type-indexed heterogeneous tuple. HOL list entries can be encoded in the disjoint union of the component carriers; typed_tuple preserves the index-specific carrier constraints. The fixed split lengths prevent ambiguous reconstruction; these containers add no new mathematical datum.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The foundation has the ordered seven components: generated order quotient, selected embedding, generated time representation, scalar order trajectory, full real observable-curve family, candidate structure and faithful transformation family, all at the same representation.
components.representation: The order quotient is a fixed type/locale carrier, while the other six components are record fields. Thus the six-field record preserves the seven-component source tuple. The observable family retains every quotient index and its own value range; the faithful family remains a separate seventh component even though also retrievable from the candidate.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Under LawTimeAdm the complete seven-component foundation exists uniquely.
components.representation: Earlier dynamic-description uniqueness fixes embedding, time representation, trajectory and observable curves; the time-relative law family fixes candidate and faithful family. HOL extensional restrictions implement equality of functions on exactly their source domains. The fixed quotient carrier is shared, so it is not an omitted free component.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Fix one generated-compatible datum at its base representation and its evaluation specification e. At each admitted rho use that transported datum. The differential atlas is supplied as additional input. The fixed e is omitted only as explicitly declared.
components.representation: The generic Atlas/coordinate_atlas is instantiated component by component with T the actual evaluation-time domain and value the actual law input/output functions. This applies to either specification branch. The native family adapter is the single-object specialization, not the proof of the joint-object case. No atlas-existence theorem from LawOperative is claimed; the atlas constructor requires all chart and coverage fields.

components.signature_domain_quantification: A nonempty countable evaluation domain has no cover by time-chart domains whose images in the reals are open. Nonemptiness belongs to the obstruction, not to each chart.
components.representation: Every subdomain is countable, so its open real image is empty. The result permits an arbitrary index family. The empty-domain control preserves the boundary case; no continuity or differentiability assumption is inserted.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Natural-number indexing of each source does not force countability of the entire source family.
components.representation: The tagged union A times N is countable exactly when A is countable. Taking A to be the reals gives countable individual sources and an uncountable total family. This checks the stated nonimplication; it does not assert that every LCTR source family is uncountable.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Select a nonempty subset of law indices; each selected component has its own positive differentiation order and two arbitrary nonnegative finite coordinate dimensions. The total dimension is their sum.
components.representation: Lean stores the selected subset and component-dependent fields. HOL is instantiated separately at each selected component, with its own index, order and finite coordinate carriers; it imposes no common family dimension. The general chart schema supplies the same construction for joint-law components. Fin 2 identifies input and output in that order. Dimension zero remains a singleton coordinate space, not an excluded case.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Time-chart indices and each side-value-chart index family are nonempty. A full index is one time index and one index for each side. Each time chart is a bijection from a subset of the evaluation domain to an open real set; each value chart is a bijection from its side-value domain to an open finite-dimensional coordinate set.
components.representation: The third link uses the native family locale only for its explicit open-image fields. In the general coordinate_atlas instantiation, Charts is precisely the product of the given index sets and the corresponding finite-dimensional open targets are retained from the input Atlas. Generic generation lemmas need no openness premise, so proving them in a weaker locale does not discard this input field. Nonempty index types do not require nonempty individual chart domains.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The product of the input and output value charts has the product domain and product image. Their finite coordinates concatenate, input first, into the sum-dimension coordinate space.
components.representation: Lean uses a dependent two-component function and HOL a pair. The checked flatten/split bijections preserve every coordinate, including zero-dimensional sides. This is not an assumption equating two unrelated value spaces.

components.signature_domain_quantification: A local jet point consists of a time in the full time-chart image, a zeroth value in the product value-chart image, and k further unrestricted vectors of the sum dimension. Each local differential relation is a subset of this full space.
components.representation: Domain is a vector family indexed 0 through k whose zeroth entry lies in the value region; HOL PiE on {..k} keeps exactly these coordinates. The relation parameter is restricted to this ambient space; MemberAt is its later use, not an imposed membership condition here. No derivative realization, smoothness, or equation satisfaction is assumed merely by forming this space. The numeric simultaneous-evaluation image can be smaller than the full time-chart image.

components.signature_domain_quantification: For every ordered pair of time charts or product value charts, the change candidate is the target chart composed with the inverse source chart, defined only on the source-coordinate image of the common source-domain overlap. The two candidate sets contain exactly these pair-indexed maps.
components.representation: The construction is a bijection between the two overlap images, including the empty-overlap case. HOL inv_into on the overlap agrees there with inversion of the original bijective chart. These candidates have no smoothness certificate at this stage. The family is the range over all ordered index pairs; it is not the family of all possible coordinate bijections.

components.signature_domain_quantification: For every evaluation time of every selected component there is a full chart index containing the time and both side values. EvalStr packages the selection, orders, dimensions, indices, complete chart families, local relations, and the two derived change families.
components.representation: Generic Atlas carries charts and simultaneous coverage; positive order and arbitrary local relation families complete the component data. Native Family packages the single-object specialization. In HOL these are component-local data and their indexed assembly, not one homogeneous record falsely imposing a uniform type or dimension. Change families are derived from the charts, so storing them as definitions rather than independent fields preserves the full tuple. The source tuple requires neither Diff1 nor Diff2 yet.

components.signature_domain_quantification: For every selected component and full chart index, simultaneous evaluation requires time-domain membership and membership of both actual law values in their side chart domains. The numeric domain is exactly the time-chart image of this intersection.
components.representation: The Lean time type is the evaluation-domain subtype and value is instantiated with the actual law value functions, for either branch. HOL fin/fout are the same functions restricted to E. No requirement of nonempty or open simultaneous intersection is introduced here.

components.signature_domain_quantification: TimeCoord is the original time chart restricted to the simultaneous domain, with its image as codomain.
components.representation: Lean imageProjection and HOL the same tc restricted to joint both retain the original numerical value. Bijectivity follows from original-chart injectivity and the image codomain, without enlarging the domain.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The local curve first inverts the time chart on the numeric simultaneous image, evaluates both actual law values at that recovered time, and applies the product value chart. Each side curve is its corresponding projection.
components.representation: The inverse into joint agrees with the inverse into the full time-chart domain on exactly this numeric image, as explicitly proved. Thus the formal inverse-domain choice is not a change of source meaning. Both side maps and their value-image memberships are retained. Outside the declared domain, HOL total-function values have no role.

components.signature_domain_quantification: TrjCoordChart is the pair of the restricted numerical time coordinate and the entire two-side local curve family.
components.representation: The pair is represented by its two already defined projections; no additional freely chosen trajectory or omitted output-side curve occurs. The construction remains relative to the selected component and chart index.

components.signature_domain_quantification: For every selected component and chart index the restricted time coordinate is bijective. Every evaluation time admits a joint chart; at its corresponding numeric time both side curves and the full product curve equal the charts applied to the original law values.
components.representation: Universal chart-wise bijectivity and pointwise existential chart coverage are distinct quantifiers. The same chosen index and time witness are used in both side identities. Generic chart results apply to either law branch; no single-object generation premise is needed here.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Restrict the bijective chart; use input simultaneous coverage to choose the index; recover the original time by inversion; substitute this identity into both side curves and the product chart.
components.representation: The proof uses no uniqueness of chart choice, smoothness, law-relation satisfaction, or openness of the numeric simultaneous image. All equations are on the declared domains.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Under atlas regularity and value-jet covariance, the value-jet change maps the source relation intersected with its overlap jet domain exactly onto the target relation intersected with the reverse overlap jet domain.
components.representation: Lean embeds the overlap-domain subtype into each full ambient jet space; HOL writes the intersections explicitly. The same regular certificate is used in the covariance and bijection. Finite-dimensional and zero-dimensional HOL cases together cover the manuscript coordinate dimensions. Equality is not asserted for unrestricted relations.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Two embeddings of the same generated order quotient define image-to-image maps in both directions, rho_j composed with the inverse of rho_i on its image.
components.representation: The common source and embedding properties give the same equality kernel and strict-order relation. imageMap is therefore the inverse-composition map, and swapping the embeddings gives its inverse. The local directed-pair set contains 0-to-1 and 1-to-0; the two embeddings need not be distinct. This is an order isomorphism of full representation images, not a smooth map asserted merely from order preservation.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The two evaluation structures both satisfy atlas regularity and share selected law indices, differentiation orders, value-chart indices and value charts. Quantification covers every selected component, both independently chosen time indices and every shared value-chart tuple.
components.representation: RawFamily order, dimensions and value charts are component-dependent but representation-independent; time indices and charts may vary with representation. The two AtlasCondition conjuncts are retained. HOL component-local schemas plus family_fifth give the family quantification without imposing a common component dimension. General chart and predicate constructions cover either specification branch; the native family is its single-object instance.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Intersect the source time-chart domain with the inverse image of the target chart domain under the actual image isomorphism, then take source coordinates. The local change is target chart after that same isomorphism after source-chart inversion.
components.representation: Pulling the target chart back along the exact time bijection produces this intersection. ReverseDomain is the target-coordinate image of the reverse overlap. HOL inverse functions and Lean inverse equivalences coincide on the declared carriers. No arbitrary reparametrization is substituted for the actual between-representation map.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The time-change jet domain is the overlap time-coordinate domain times the shared value region times all derivative vectors of orders 1 through k.
components.representation: The shared value region restricts only coordinate zero of Domain k; all higher coordinates remain arbitrary. sourceAmbient and targetAmbient preserve every numerical coordinate while placing the overlap point in the appropriate full jet space. This domain is not restricted to jets attained by the generated trajectory.

components.signature_domain_quantification: For each directed choice the overlap is open, the actual chart change is C^k there and its reverse is its inverse. Both directions are included.
components.representation: TimeChange retains source/target openness, forward/backward carrier maps, both smoothness fields and both inverse identities. BoundTimeChange ties these maps to the actual charts. These are input conditions of Diff5, not consequences of order isomorphism alone.

components.signature_domain_quantification: A unique full jet map exists between the overlap jet domains and acts on every admissible C^k value-curve germ by composing the curve with the reverse time change and moving the base time forward.
components.representation: The certificate supplies the lift and reverse lift; Acts quantifies over all admissible curves, not only the generated one. Every finite jet has a smooth realization, so agreement on these germs proves uniqueness on the complete jet domain. The time coordinate and zero-through-k coordinates together comprise the displayed jet. Different certificates with the same actual charts yield the same map.

components.signature_domain_quantification: For every point of the overlap jet domain, membership in the source local relation is equivalent to membership of its image in the target local relation.
components.representation: This is a biconditional on the complete restricted domain. It is neither one-way preservation nor a check only along one trajectory. Certificate independence is proved with the actual chart equalities and does not discard the covariance condition.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The full time-image map is a strictly monotone order isomorphism. Under Diff5, the actual time-jet map sends the source relation intersected with its change domain exactly to the target relation intersected with the reverse domain.
components.representation: The order assertion follows from the shared generated quotient, independently of Diff5. The relation-image assertion additionally uses the complete two-direction analytic certificate and covariance. The inverse on the overlap supplies surjectivity needed for equality; inclusion alone is not counted as the result.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Each embedding is an order isomorphism to its own image. Their inverse composition preserves order in both directions. Under Diff5 the jet map is bijective and membership is equivalent, yielding the restricted set-image equality.
components.representation: The full-order-image argument and the local-jet argument have separate premises. The proof does not infer differentiability from monotonicity.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The evaluation-structure family ranges over every admitted representation of the fixed evaluation specification. Selection, orders, value indices and value charts are shared; each component uses the law datum transported to its own representation.
components.representation: Time-index fibres and time charts are not forced to agree between representations. Actual law inputs/outputs remain bound to the transported component. General family quantification is over Omega[e]; the concrete native Rep carrier specializes that set, not a finite sample.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Conditions 1 through 4 have one representation argument, and condition 5 has two. DiffPred chooses exactly the named analytic predicate; each universal condition quantifies over all admitted tuples of its own arity.
components.representation: Source nodes 1..5 correspond to Fin 5 values 0..4 and HOL N1..N5. The proof-dependent Lean member/value/time fields retain their jet/atlas prerequisites through existential witnesses; HOL retains them as explicit conjuncts. The actual component projection connects these fields to analytic conditions. In particular Diff2 is not silently replaced by Diff1-and-Diff2, and Diff5 retains both representation prerequisites.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The direct edges are exactly 1-to-2, 2-to-3, 1-to-4 and 1-to-5. Each edge strictly increases the index and the graph is acyclic.
components.representation: The graph nodes remain condition indices, not their Boolean values. The ancestor relation is exactly the transitive closure and is irreflexive. An evaluation-stage predecessor is not a claim of logical implication between the native predicates: the checked independent-jet control preserves this distinction.

components.signature_domain_quantification: DiffEvalDat contains the base representation, the base law datum and the differential structure family belonging to them. The base representation uniquely fixes how that law datum is transported to each admitted representation.
