components.signature_domain_quantification: Pure means the selected subtype occurs and every other subtype at that node does not. Remainders are both cases at nodes1,3,4; off-generated conflict at node2; false at node5.
components.representation: Mutual exclusion is created at the pure-type level, not asserted for raw occurrences. In the equivalence with uncovered remainder, the evaluation must belong to the parent; raw_parent carries exactly the ancestor-and-failure facts.

components.signature_domain_quantification: A child is parent membership plus its pure predicate. Root children are the specified subtype set; every first child has no further child. NodeReg assigns parents and children, and cov/unref at roots are union-of-children and parent-minus-union.
components.representation: Instantiate the generic region forest on Ev predicates, with an empty second-child type. Fixed-native-family regions give the matching specialization; generic Forest/Regions impose no shared law-data carriers across Ev. Terminal children have empty cover and their entire region as unrefined remainder.

components.signature_domain_quantification: At each root, cov is the pairwise-disjoint union of pure children and parent is the disjoint union of cov and unref. On parent, unref iff LawUnrefCase. Node5 unref is empty and cov equals parent. Refinement inclusion and equality on retained indices give cov growth and unref shrinkage.
components.representation: Apply the native remainder theorem at each selected datum; then set extensionality and generic forest decomposition give the global statements. This avoids treating the fixed-carrier specialization as an additional premise. Monotonicity uses one arbitrary index embedding with equal retained child regions; it does not drop the source agreement condition.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The proof derives each remainder separately: mixed node1, nongenerated node2, mixed node3, mixed node4, and no remainder at node5; purity gives disjointness and the generic forest provides the decomposition.
components.representation: All native predicates are evaluated at the same chosen datum within each Ev. The statements are universally available at each datum even if its type parameters vary across Ev.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Sigma_law has one membership indicator for each of the five law tokens in the strict failed-token set, at every complete Ev.
components.representation: Restrict the native failure indicator to law-series tokens; Booleanfalse/true encodes0/1. Law tokens belong to the strict partition, not the approximation series. This total five-component signature is distinct from downstream tagged diagnostic availability.

components.signature_domain_quantification: At a specified node, DynOperative, all ancestor conditions and FailReady=true imply FL_i iff that token is strictly failed. If these hypotheses hold at every law node, the signature equals the vector of FL_i indicators.
components.representation: Readiness includes law selected-domain formation, evaluated input and predecessor satisfaction; it is not inferred from DynOperative alone. state_failed_iff then leaves exactly the false condition. Full-vector equality uses the hypotheses for every node, not one node.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Strict-set membership, failed state, false failure evaluation, false native condition and FL_i coincide under the stated readiness and ancestor hypotheses.
components.representation: The coherent selected argument carries the same complete evaluation into the recursion. No absent, unformed or unevaluable state is identified with failure.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Each parent is contained in EvSpec; each child and each unrefined remainder are contained in its parent. The five-bit signature is a function on EvSpec.
components.representation: The inclusions are predicate-conjunction and set-difference consequences, independent of globally shared law carriers. They hold also for empty regions; they do not claim coverage by pure children alone.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The differential selected domain is a subset of the same selected law domain. Each datum is the ordered triple of base representation, that law datum and a differential structure family belonging to its transported law family.
components.representation: The third component is parametrized by the selected law datum, not freely attached. Basis.rho supplies the first component. The native family adapter checks ownership; pointwise application preserves the source selection even when evaluation-specific carrier data vary.

components.signature_domain_quantification: At fixed selected Ev, condition and ancestor components may omit the Ev suffix. Formation equals differential-selected-domain membership; evaluation-input satisfaction is true.
components.representation: These abbreviations retain the same chosen datum. They do not identify selection with operativity. Upstream law operativity remains inside the ancestor bundle, independently of the true evaluation-input flag.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Localize failure by DAG-minimal false conditions, allowing simultaneous failure at mutually unreachable nodes.
components.representation: The direct edges are1→2,2→3,1→4,1→5. Their transitive closure defines ancestry. These are evaluation dependencies, not logical implications between predicates; in particular Diff2 is not replaced by Diff1 AND Diff2.

components.signature_domain_quantification: On all EvSpec, condition and ancestor evaluation are existential extensions from the selected differential family, with the witness required equal to Ev.
components.representation: Existence of a selected-domain witness becomes domain conjunction in HOL and a proof-indexed datum in Lean. Both condition and ancestor extension are false outside selection. In-domain they equal the original selected components, not a new choice.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Failure-condition and differential-condition index sets are the same five-node set; both K notations denote exactly the universal native differential condition.
components.representation: Node1..5 corresponds to Fin5 0..4 or N1..N5. The actual analytic predicate meanings, proof-dependent prerequisites and arities are imported from the completed Chapter5 correspondence rather than replaced by arbitrary Boolean labels.

components.signature_domain_quantification: At node1, ancestor satisfaction is the same selected law datum operativity and selected-domain membership. Differential failure adds negation of all five conditions; FailDom is the corresponding subset of EvSpec.
components.representation: The empty internal ancestor set at node1 contributes true but does not remove the external law-operativity conjunct. False total conditions outside selection do not imply differential failure.

components.signature_domain_quantification: For selected Ev, differential failure iff LawOperative of its selected law datum and not DiffOperative of the same triple.
components.representation: DiffOperative is exactly same-law operativity AND the complete native condition family. The outer law-ready conjunct is retained when negating this conjunction; not DiffOperative alone is not equivalent to differential failure.

components.signature_domain_quantification: FDiff_i is its all-ancestor bundle conjoined with not Ki on every complete evaluation.
components.representation: The bundle includes law operativity and every strict differential ancestor, all at this evaluation. The definition therefore preserves selected-domain and external-stage guards at every node.

components.signature_domain_quantification: On selected Ev, FDiff_i iff the ancestor bundle holds and an admitted tuple of time representations of arity(i) violates DiffPred_i. The tuple length is1 for nodes1..4 and2 for node5.
components.representation: Negating universal quantification gives existential quantification of the same arity. Lean negates existential proof-dependent jet/atlas witnesses into forall-proofs negation; HOL uses the equivalent implication negation. Under minimality the ancestor bundle supplies those prerequisites. Empty representation domains yield no witness rather than an invented representative.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Rows retain atlas regularity, generated jet existence, generated jet relation membership, value-chart jet covariance, and two-time-representation jet covariance. Their internal ancestor sets are empty,{1},{1,2},{1},{1}, each additionally requiring law operativity.
components.representation: The third/fourth/fifth failure is interpreted only with the indicated predecessors satisfied. The fourth row compares value charts; the fifth compares two time representations. Native analytic definitions supply the meanings of all table labels.

components.signature_domain_quantification: For each of the five indices, the parent is the set of evaluations in the failure domain satisfying that minimal-failure predicate. Its domain is EvSpec, not the entire unguarded representation type.
components.representation: The simplified native definition S AND minimalFailure is equal to S AND failure AND minimalFailure by the cover theorem. Native classification is pointwise at each selected datum; for global set operations use the resulting predicate on EvSpec, without requiring common representation carriers across evaluations.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Any indexed family of subregions lying within the parent is allowed. RefSplit is the union of those subregions and its complement relative to the parent; those two sets are disjoint and their union is the parent.
components.representation: The individual children need not be pairwise disjoint or cover the parent. Empty child families leave the full parent unrefined. The generic forest applies directly to the global native predicate sets; the native wrapper is a fixed-carrier specialization, not a premise of the global statement.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Antichain means absence of strict reachable paths in both directions between distinct members. MinFailIdx is exactly the set of indices satisfying FDiff at the same evaluation.
components.representation: Fin5 zero-based indices correspond to source indices1..5. Relation.TransGen and tranclp encode the strict transitive closure E+, not just direct edges and not reflexive reachability. The empty set is an antichain but later excluded when failure is assumed.

components.signature_domain_quantification: On EvSpec, differential failure iff at least one of the five minimal failures holds, equivalently the failure domain equals the union of all five parent regions.
components.representation: Union here is an overlapping cover, not a partition. Pointwise native equivalence permits evaluation-dependent carrier data; restricting both sides to EvSpec gives the stated set equality.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The forward direction obtains a false node minimal in the finite differential DAG. Its strict ancestors are satisfied and law operativity persists. The reverse direction obtains law operativity from the ancestor bundle and failure of the full differential bundle from the false node.
components.representation: The finite five-node implementation proves the same implication by cases. It neither infers law operativity from a differential predicate alone nor counts evaluations outside the selected domain as failures.

components.signature_domain_quantification: For an evaluation in the differential failure domain, MinFailIdx is a nonempty antichain. Each proposed path contradicts the false condition at one endpoint and the ancestor bundle at the other.
components.representation: Both directed paths are excluded. Nonemptiness depends on the failure premise, unlike the pairwise antichain argument. Distinct simultaneous minima are allowed; they are not forced into a single first-failure index.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The cover is relative to the specified five universal differential conditions. Each parent splits into covered and unrefined parts.
components.representation: No completeness claim for a different condition family and no claim that internal refinement is exhaustive are added.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The product of the five parents is nonempty iff every parent is nonempty iff a family of evaluations in EvSpec supplies one minimal-failure witness for every index.
components.representation: Use P_i equal to the full source parent set, n=5 in Lean and a five-element I in HOL. Lean dependent functions of subtypes and HOL functions satisfying indexed membership both encode the Cartesian product. The generic theorem imposes no fixed law or differential carrier across evaluations. This is an equivalence criterion, not an assertion that all parents are inhabited.

components.signature_domain_quantification: For the supplied witness family in the parent product, its image itself lies in EvSpec, is finite, has cardinality at most five and meets every parent.
components.representation: Set.range w in Lean and w image I in HOL are exactly the source set of supplied witnesses. Repeated witnesses are permitted, so the bound is at most five, not exactly five. The old existential finite-set theorem is not substituted for this specified-set conclusion.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Simultaneous nonemptiness is expressed by the witness product; construction of witnesses then determines the finite witness set.
components.representation: The conditional witness construction is preserved. A criterion and a supplied-family corollary do not assert an unconditional physical realization of each failure class.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Root children are the first-layer index family, their children are the second-layer family, and second-layer nodes have no children. NodeReg assigns the matching parent, first or second subregion, each child included in its parent.
components.representation: Lean dependent indices and HOL guarded sets encode the same three node levels. Apply the generic forest to the global Ev predicate sets; native-carrier specialization is not imposed across evaluations. Empty child-index sets are allowed.

components.signature_domain_quantification: For cov and unref, root node regions agree with parent covered/unrefined regions. First-layer covered/unrefined regions are the split of that first-layer subregion by its second children.
components.representation: Covered is the union of immediate child regions; unrefined is parent minus that union. Individual children are not assumed mutually disjoint.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Two root snapshots share the same parent and retain equal regions on the embedded old index family. The covered region grows while the unrefined region shrinks.
components.representation: The embedding/agreement premise is the referenced source refinement-monotonicity assumption, not unrestricted monotonicity under arbitrary changes to children or parent.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Every node decomposes into covered and unrefined regions, child regions give a disjoint union when pairwise disjointness holds, descendants lie in ancestors, and the two specified snapshots satisfy monotonicity.
components.representation: The proof is substitution into the generic forest and snapshot theorems. Conditional disjointness keeps its hypothesis. Ancestor inclusion follows the child path, not a reversed subset.

components.signature_domain_quantification: For a selected differential evaluation, differential failure implies law operativity and absence of differential operativity. Differential operativity implies the same selected law datum is operative.
components.representation: The source uses abbreviated law/differential data from the same Ev. This is not equivalence of the two stages and does not discard law readiness.

components.signature_domain_quantification: FL evaluates general-law relations; FA evaluates quantitative defect thresholds, continuous extension, order and relation stability; FDiff evaluates atlas regularity, generated jets, local jet membership and covariance. FL3/4 and FDiff3/4/5 act on the separately defined objects.
components.representation: Reuse the exact native condition definitions, not their short table names. An implication from FA to FDiff needs correspondence between their input data; no unprovided conversion is inferred. The Japanese math-array and English text-table carry the same three rows.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The differential signature on every Ev has five components, each the indicator of FDiff_i.
components.representation: Boolean false/true encodes0/1. This signature is defined from minimal failure even when global token-readiness hypotheses do not hold; it is not unconditionally identified with the recursive token signature.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The signature support equals MinFailIdx. On the failure domain it is nonzero and its support is a nonempty antichain.
components.representation: The zero vector is the constant-false function. Both strict reachability directions are excluded, while nonemptiness retains the failure-domain premise.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Given the same node ancestor bundle and FailReady, FDiff_i iff its token belongs to FailedTok_strict.
components.representation: Readiness requires formation, evaluated input and predecessor satisfaction. The recursive assignment matches the native universal condition at that node. Differential tokens are strict, unlike approximation tokens.

components.signature_domain_quantification: If the stated ancestor/readiness hypotheses hold for every node, the token membership indicators equal all five signature components. The proof passes through failed state, false native condition and the ancestor-conjoined minimal-failure predicate.
components.representation: A single-node hypothesis cannot establish whole-vector equality. Unformed or unevaluable states are not failed states.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The construction determines four outputs: the differential DAG, five parent regions, five unrefined remainders, and the five-bit signature at every evaluation.
components.representation: For fixed supplied child regions, the output record is unique. Global parents and signatures are pointwise native predicates on EvSpec; remainders use set difference, independently of uniform law carriers. This supplies the listed output family, not a new physical-existence assertion.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Record the five scale-independent series and the scale-dependent approximation series separately at the same complete evaluation.
components.representation: The six sizes are8,3,8,9,5,5;29strict and9approximation tokens. Scale independence concerns the strict state at fixed Ev, not equality of the different series.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The six-series signature is the dependent product of indicator vectors with the six declared lengths. Its law component is the component at the law-series tag.
components.representation: Lean dependent function(i,j) and HOL token-indexed Boolean function encode the same product. HOL values are masked outside the38-token carrier. Booltrue/false encodes1/0; equal predicates do not merge token identities.

components.signature_domain_quantification: At the coherent recursive state section, all failed tokens are exactly the dependency-minimal failed tokens. Each signature component equals membership of its token in this failed set.
components.representation: Minimality is structural in the reflexive-transitive failure-dependency order, not numeric index order or earliest clock time. Recurs is supplied by the defined state section, not assumed for arbitrary states.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The strict scale fibre consists of all scales when the fixed evaluation is strictly valid and none otherwise. Approximate and full fibres restrict their global domains to the same fixed Ev.
components.representation: The strict profile has no scale argument; approximation retains one. Fibre formation does not infer failure from noncompletion.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The approximation-boundary signature consists of the nine indicators of strict defect excess over the corresponding threshold.
components.representation: Ev is fixed in the abbreviated I_exc[lambda]. ENNReal in Lean corresponds to explicitly nonnegative ereal values in HOL, including infinity. Saturation equality is not excess. This quantitative boundary signature is distinct from the recursive failed-token signature.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The full-validity scale fibre is exactly the intersection of the strict and approximation fibres.
components.representation: At each scale, full completion is the conjunction of strict completion and approximation completion; set extensionality then gives the equality.

components.signature_domain_quantification: On the totally ordered scale domain with every defect component nondecreasing, the approximation-validity fibre is initial and equals the maximal initial valid subset, provided InputSat holds at every scale. If every scale is valid, the maximal interval is the whole domain.
components.representation: The ScaleInput inputs field is the explicit source universal InputSat premise. Native matching ties all nine encoded defects to their actual condition values. Finite qualitative components use the existing0/1 defect encoding; thresholds are fixed across scale.

components.signature_domain_quantification: When the complement has a least scale, the maximal interval ends immediately before that scale and the approximation-boundary signature there is nonzero.
components.representation: No least boundary is manufactured from totality or monotonicity. The full inherited conclusion includes zero boundary signature at every earlier scale under the same input/monotonicity hypotheses.

components.signature_domain_quantification: For each of the nine indices and each scale, equality of defect and threshold implies the corresponding condition is true.
components.representation: The threshold condition is non-strict less-than-or-equal; the boundary/excess criterion is strict greater-than. The equality statement remains valid at extended-real infinity.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Boundary data are all pairs of a least invalid scale and its boundary signature. They are empty if all scales are valid or invalid scales have no least element, and a singleton when the boundary exists.
components.representation: A least element is not merely a minimal element or an infimum. Source BdryExc/BdrySig/BdryDatum are only evaluated when the least boundary is defined. The generic representation permits a present boundary with zero signature; nonzero quantitative conclusions require the separate native conditions.

components.signature_domain_quantification: FirstFailRep is the ordered triple of all minimal structural failed positions, the six-series signature and the approximation-boundary data. The triple is uniquely determined.
components.representation: Uniqueness of the recursive state and uniqueness of a least element supply different parts of the proof. The boundary set can be empty without erasing structural failures.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Structural multiplicity classifies the failed-token set. Boundary multiplicity independently classifies zero, one or at least two excess components at an existing boundary, with absent also covering empty boundary data or a zero boundary signature. MultRep is the ordered pair.
components.representation: HOL masks signature outside its nine-component carrier, corresponding to Lean Fin9. Non-absent implies an existing boundary, but absent does not imply boundary nonexistence. No injectivity or independence between the two cardinalities is claimed.

components.signature_domain_quantification: FailUnique means exactly one failed token; recursive minimality makes it the unique structural minimal position and exactly one of the38 indicator components is1.
components.representation: Uniqueness is across the full tagged token carrier, not just within one series. A token at another series with the same local index is distinct.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Structural parallel classification entails at least two failed tokens. Boundary parallel classification entails at least two excess components at the boundary. The two report components depend on their respective cardinalities.
components.representation: The quantitative signature-support correspondence identifies the finite set with source excess components. A nonempty boundary-support class supplies the least boundary before reading its signature.

components.signature_domain_quantification: On the declared scale-augmented evaluation domain, nonempty failure gives nonempty structural minima, and state-based versus minimal-position-based constructions give the same six-series signature.
components.representation: Coverage is exactly the declared six-series token carrier. Multiple minima within one series or across series are retained. It is not a completeness claim for arbitrary undeclared conditions.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The structural-target carrier is a distinct copy of the tagged six-series failure-token carrier, and StructOf preserves each series and local index.
components.representation: Lean wraps its dependent finite Token; HOL wraps its native_token subtype. The local HOL index is one-based, whereas Lean Fin is zero-based. The six sizes remain8,3,8,9,5,5.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Desc is the principal upper set in the reflexive-transitive dependency order. Structural burden is the union of its StructOf images over the supplied roots.
components.representation: Reflexive closure includes the root itself. Burden denotes the dependency-upward structural range, not the set of all actually failed descendants. The arbitrary-relation kernel specializes to the declared native edge closure.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Position burden starts from the current failed-token set. Boundary burden is empty when boundary data are empty; at a least invalid scale it starts from the approximation tokens at the excess-signature support.
components.representation: HOL lifted_burden converts the exact38-token carrier into its native subtype. Boundary support contributes only series3 and nine valid indices. A present zero-signature boundary can also yield empty burden; no converse from empty burden to absent boundary is asserted.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The burden report is the ordered pair of the position-side and boundary-side subsets of structural tokens.
components.representation: The two fields are retained separately even if their sets happen to coincide. The assembled record supplies the actual failed set and boundary support, rather than treating them as unrelated arbitrary inputs.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Singleton burden equals its principal-upper image; inclusion of root sets implies inclusion of burdens. A root in A whose singleton burden is not contained in burden(B) gives a witness in burden(A) minus burden(B).
components.representation: The proof retains both premises s in A and singleton noncontainment. It does not infer structural separation merely from A differing from B.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The six-series table fixes token cardinalities and index-preserving target assignment. Each burden component has powerset codomain and their ordered report has the product codomain.
components.representation: Displayed table entries are restatements of these carriers and fields, not additional mathematical claims.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The report is unique; every failed root contributes its full singleton burden to the position component. At an existing boundary every excess approximation root contributes its singleton burden to the boundary component.
components.representation: Both containments follow by inclusion of a singleton root in the defining union. Boundary existence remains a premise of the second indexed assertion.

components.signature_domain_quantification: FailLocData contains the three scale-validity domains, maximal initial interval, first-failure triple, multiplicity pair, burden pair and six-series signature.
components.representation: A record flattens the first nested triple into three named fields without deleting or combining any component. All fields use the same evaluation state family and boundary-signature function.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The assembled outputs are unique. Full validity is the intersection of strict and approximation validity. The maximal initial interval is contained in approximation validity, with equality under the resolution theorem hypotheses. Recursive state evaluation and minimal-position signatures agree.
components.representation: Interval equality is conditional: the source universal InputSat and monotone native defects provide the pointwise bridge and initiality. HOL normalizes values outside the38-token carrier; no such extra coordinates exist in Lean.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The profile consists of the full-validity predicate, the four state fibers and the boundary data at the same complete evaluation and scale.
components.representation: A datatype-indexed fiber function encodes the four ordered fields. Internal sat/failed/unformed/unevaluable states are distinct from the later five operational audit states. The boundary datum uses the same masked nine-component signature as localization.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The table associates all-satisfied validity and nonempty failed, unformed and unevaluable fibers with their appropriate outputs; a singleton boundary yields its scale, signature and burden.
components.representation: These are predicates on sets of tokens, not mutually exclusive global alternatives. Distinct fibers may both be nonempty although every individual token has exactly one state.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The four state fibers form a disjoint cover, allowing empty fibers, of the whole adopted token carrier. Full validity holds exactly when the satisfied fiber is the whole carrier.
components.representation: SatTok[lambda] abbreviates the same fixed Ev fiber; it does not drop an independently varying argument. Lean univ is the exact dependent Token type, corresponding to HOL tokens rather than every ambient nat pair.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Every failed token has exactly one series tag. The reports recover the minimal positions, signature, multiplicity, scale boundary and burden; profile fields agree with localization outputs.
components.representation: These statements are restricted to the declared evaluation domain and six-series carrier. Recursive solution uniqueness supplies report determinacy, rather than assuming equality of all possible state functions.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Classification completeness quantifies over the adopted six series and scale-augmented evaluations. The prose synthesis and figure caption restate their validity and dependency-minimal localization results.
components.representation: The adopted figure introduces no additional logical structure. Undeclared conditions are outside this relative quantifier domain.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The operational construction takes the tagged native failure system and the uniquely constructed localization datum for the same scale-augmented evaluation.
components.representation: The core computation and provenance certificate are retained separately; later operational statuses are computed from the existing internal state section.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Exactly approximation, law and differential series have branch inputs. Each branch is a disjoint sum of its own formed input type and an unformed reason. Input also retains configuration and complete evaluation.
components.representation: Lean uses the dependent BranchType family; HOL core_input is a parameter instantiated with the configuration/evaluation/three-sum tuple. Left and right injections are never collapsed even when underlying value carriers coincide.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Condition evidence retains every native condition index, with the five strict series independent of scale and approximation evidence indexed by every scale. EvidenceAt reads the appropriate component from this family.
components.representation: Lean EvidenceType depends on the full tagged token; HOL uses E t and explicit evidence_typed membership. Approximation indices0..8 correspond to native HOL token indices1..9. ScaleData denotes the supplied tuple of scale order, scale set, defect codomains and thresholds, not proof of their physical validity.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The computation core has contract, input, condition evidence and scale data. The separate certificate has input identifier, evidence identifier, content hash, transformation trace and evidence location. AuditData is their ordered pair.
components.representation: All five provenance fields remain separate in the report. The time-type suffix is omitted only after the explicit local notation declaration; no component or type parameter is deleted.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The component-family definition and payload table restate the four core fields, per-condition evidence and all five certificate fields.
components.representation: The certificate records provenance while the fixed core and evaluation contract determine computation. Certificate changes need not change status values, but the complete report still retains the changed certificate.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The five values are distinct, ordered Pass<Indeterminate<Unformed<Blocked<Fail. The lift first tests immediate-predecessor satisfaction: false yields Blocked; true selects from the four internal states.
components.representation: The predecessor Boolean is derived from the same recursive internal state, not an unrelated free flag. Group priority is a display/aggregation order, not a temporal or dependency order.

components.signature_domain_quantification: State fibers classify tokens by equality of operational status. Every one of the six nonempty finite series has a unique attained maximal-priority state, yielding the six-tuple.
components.representation: HOL i<6 is Lean Fin6 membership. Nonemptiness is proved from native series cardinalities, rather than silently assigning a default status to an empty group.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The indeterminate set is its exact status fiber and the indeterminate signature is its tokenwise indicator.
components.representation: Bool represents the displayed0/1 codomain. This signature is not the failed-token signature and does not treat unknown evidence as failure.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Undefined reasons are token/status pairs restricted to Blocked, Unformed and Indeterminate. Each series restricts to its token subset and the global reason set is their union.
components.representation: Pass and Fail are not undefined reasons. HOL uses explicit reason-carrier membership whereas Lean encodes the same restriction by a subtype.

components.signature_domain_quantification: TaggedResult returns the value for an empty reason set and the nonempty reason set otherwise; the two tags are distinct. Its object-type subscript is locally omitted when uniquely inferable.
components.representation: Lean NonemptySet enforces the codomain in the type; HOL tagged_carrier and no_empty_reason_tag enforce it on the represented subset. Ambient Inr empty is outside that carrier and is not an admitted output.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Four diagnostic fields are tagged failed positions, failure signature, boundary data and burden pair. Boundary uses approximation-local reasons; the other three use global reasons. The full report retains data, five-field state report and four-field diagnostic report.
components.representation: The native audit-fail fiber equals the internal failed fiber under the recursive evaluation, so the diagnostic payload is the source failed set. Boundary value and roots are the previously generated localization inputs; generic report types do not assert they are independently produced.

components.signature_domain_quantification: ReportOf receives operational data and scale, derives five-valued conditions from the four-valued section and predecessors, forms state and diagnostic fields, and retains the originating data.
components.representation: The dependency arrows and table denote this component construction. They do not make the displayed state section a sufficient standalone input without its predecessor relation and localization data.

components.signature_domain_quantification: For the declared recursive state, each token has one audit status, each series has a unique priority maximum, and local/global reason sets are determined independently of a chosen linear extension.
components.representation: Pass iff internal sat relies on the coherence of the recursive state and predecessor Boolean. It is not a theorem for arbitrary unrelated p and s. The finite runner supplies the same unique state as the native recursion.

components.signature_domain_quantification: Given the operational datum and scale, the report and all its components are uniquely determined. Its four computational component families retain their distinct evaluation roles.
components.representation: Completeness is relative to the supplied typed input and evidence. The exact contract determines evaluations; no independent provenance verification or physical truth is inferred from a bare hash field.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The supplied data isomorphism preserves the audit contract and types, six semantic series and dependency structure, formed/evidence values, scale order and defect/threshold data, all five provenance correspondences, and token-to-structural-target correspondence.
components.representation: The typed readout contract exposes the resulting three evaluation and two boundary correspondences. These are consequences required of the source data isomorphism, not extra hypotheses inferred from a bare bijection. Semantic series names stay fixed; token indices may be transported within them. The scale/value-order theorem supplies the boundary and threshold bridge.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The induced full report map is a bijection, commutes with typed readout at corresponding scales, and is unique among maps with the prescribed action on every report component.
components.representation: Uniqueness is not among arbitrary bijections that happen to map one report to another. The data, state and diagnostic component actions are fixed by the input isomorphism. All five transformed certificate fields are retained.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The proof transports the native recursion, five-valued condition outputs, series maxima, reason fibers, signatures, scale boundary and both burden components, then combines the component maps.
components.representation: Underlying state transport is proved from edge and evaluation preservation; full report equality is the conclusion. Reachability uses reflexive-transitive closure. Boundary absence/existence and excess support are transported, not replaced by a chosen numeric boundary.

components.signature_domain_quantification: The fragment retains the finite contract/input/evidence values, finite dependency relation, used scale comparisons/defects/thresholds and boundary data, every singleton structural image and the corresponding finite certificate portion. Each token retains formation, evaluability and condition values.
components.representation: Finite postprocessing takes the supplied boundary data and singleton images as inputs.
